rule_candidates.rule: WHEN a realised-volatility range break fires (5-20 day RV above its trailing 60-180 day 90-100% quantile) THEN don't expect trend-following to earn more than usual over the next 5-20 days; the trend ensemble has earned less than its own mean after such breaks
rule_candidates.when: universe L crypto perps, 1d or 4h bars; onset = first bar the w-day log RV exceeds its trailing N-day q-quantile, declustered 20 days
rule_candidates.then: don't add or scale trend exposure because volatility broke out; read a vol range break as a whipsaw warning, not a confirmation; it is not an exit signal either (R-EXIT-1)
rule_candidates.effect: 10-day ensemble excess P&L walk-forward in-sample -0.037/day (t -2.43, 1d) and -0.075 (t -2.37, 4h); frozen detector holdout -0.086 (t -2.97, 24 events, 1d), -0.102 (t -1.59, 4h); 89-96% of range-grid points negative in-sample, 89-100% in the holdout
rule_candidates.review: register the negative direction as its own hypothesis and keep it only if the forward excess after range breaks stays < 0 with t < -2 over the next 100 events

rule_candidates.rule: WHEN upside or downside realised semivariance breaks above its own trailing quantile while the other side does not THEN don't read the dominant side as the direction of the next 5-20 days; it mostly restates the trailing return
rule_candidates.when: 1d or 4h; RS+ / RS- over 5-20 days vs their trailing 60-180 day 80-95% quantiles; first bar of a one-sided break
rule_candidates.then: no directional preference from semivariance dominance; use the semivariances for the vol forecast only
rule_candidates.effect: walk-forward signed 10-day net return -0.077 sigma (t -1.04, 1d) and -0.037 (t -0.59, 4h); dominant side agrees with the trailing-return sign in 69-80% of events; 4h holdout +0.165 bucket-weighted (t 1.20) but about -0.02 event-weighted (45 events)
rule_candidates.review: a registered re-test that conditions on semivariance dominance AGAINST the trailing return (the non-momentum part) shows t > 2 in both segments

rule_candidates.rule: WHEN tempted to gate trend entries by a volatility break of structure plus a fractal price break and semivariance agreement THEN don't expect a better trend book; the in-sample-best gate is a selection artefact and its timing is no better than a time-shifted gate
rule_candidates.when: trend-zoo ensemble, 1d/4h, 992-config grid of vol-BoS detector x fractal k x semivariance filter x exit
rule_candidates.then: keep the plain ensemble's entries and exits; if exposure must be cut, say so and cut it directly rather than through a vol-BoS timing story
rule_candidates.effect: final pick Sharpe 0.35 vs 0.44 unfiltered in-sample (43% exposure), DSR 0.22 (SR0 0.68, 992 trials), PBO 0.84 (CSCV 16 blocks); holdout -0.46 vs -0.12; holdout Sharpe at the 50th percentile of 200 time-shifted gates; adding the opposite-BoS exit cut in-sample Sharpe 0.35 -> 0.13
rule_candidates.review: a pre-registered filter beats the ensemble in a forward window with DSR > 0.95 and PBO < 0.5 on its own grid

rule_candidates.rule: WHEN a vol-BoS or semivariance-break threshold is learned on history THEN expect the best threshold to move out of sample; don't trust a single tuned quantile
rule_candidates.when: quantile thresholds 0.80-1.00 over 60-180 day trailing windows, 1d/4h, pooled crypto
rule_candidates.then: use fixed, coarse thresholds chosen a priori, or report the whole surface; never act on a grid optimum alone
rule_candidates.effect: holdout optimum inside the in-sample top quintile for 2 of 4 surfaces (split-half in-sample analogue also 2 of 4); in-sample vs holdout surface rank corr -0.11 to +0.50; walk-forward picks change family or freq in 5 of 8 block transitions
rule_candidates.review: a forward window where >= 3 of 4 surfaces keep their optimum in the frozen top quintile

worked: A robust NEGATIVE pattern: after a realised-vol range break (5-20 day RV above its trailing 60-180 day 90-100% quantile) the trend ensemble earns LESS than its own mean over the next 5-20 days. Walk-forward in-sample range|1d -0.037/day (t -2.43), range|4h -0.075 (t -2.37); the frozen detector in the holdout -0.086 (t -2.97, 24 events, 1d) and -0.102 (t -1.59, 4h). Across the whole range grid 89-96% of configurations are negative in-sample and 89-100% in the holdout (descriptive, fig2). CUSUM alarms point the same way in-sample (cusum|4h t -2.33) but not in the holdout. This is the opposite of the registered direction, so it is a candidate to register, not knowledge.

The nested purged walk-forward, DSR and PBO did their job: they show that every in-sample 'winner' here is a selection artefact (final strategy DSR 0.22 against SR0 0.68 for 992 trials; PBO 0.84; the WF picks switch family or frequency in 5 of 8 block transitions).

The frozen machinery is reusable: causal detectors with quantile thresholds (unit-tested: appending bars never changes past flags, a planted x4 vol shift is caught within 5 bars by range, CUSUM and HAR), fractal BoS/CHoCH, and a trade builder that reproduces evaluate.strategy_pnl exactly.
did_not: H-VBOS1: vol BoS is not the timing filter trend was missing. No family x freq test is positive with t > 2 (best vov|4h +0.028/day, t 0.81; all Holm p = 1); the frozen vov|4h detector is negative in the holdout (-0.057, t -1.16).

H-VBOS2: which semivariance side breaks first does not point the next 10 days. WF signed return 1d -0.077 sigma (t -1.04), 4h -0.037 (t -0.59). The dominant side agrees with the sign of the trailing return in 69-80% of events, so it is a momentum proxy, and short-horizon momentum after vol expansion does not continue (cf. R-VSIG-2). The 4h holdout bucket-weighted mean is +0.165 (t 1.20), which literally meets the holdout sign criterion, but the event-weighted mean is about -0.02 (up +0.005, down -0.060) and n is 45: the pooled verdict stays 'contradicts'.

H-VBOS3: 'trend following with market-structure awareness' as specified (enter on a fractal BoS in the ensemble's direction while a vol BoS is active and the dominant semivariance agrees; ensemble or opposite-BoS exit) does not beat the plain ensemble. The in-sample final pick (4h, har_1.5_3, fractal k 3, semivariance on, own exits) has Sharpe 0.35 vs 0.44 for the unfiltered 4h ensemble on the same days at 43% exposure; holdout -0.46 vs -0.12. Its holdout Sharpe equals the median of 200 time-shifted gates, so the vol-BoS timing contributes nothing; the filter is an exposure cut (R-EXIT-2), and here it even cut the good days.
The opposite-BoS exit hurt in-sample (ablation: 0.35 -> 0.13 when switched on), the same lesson as R-EXIT-1: structure-based exits are tight trails.

H-VBOS4: thresholds are not stable. 2 of 4 holdout optima fall inside the in-sample top quintile (range|1d, semi|1d) and 2 do not; surface rank correlations in-sample vs holdout are -0.11 / +0.50 (range 1d / 4h) and +0.23 / -0.08 (semi); the split-half in-sample analogue also gives 2 of 4.

TradFi T cannot test the selection: history starts 2026-04..08, so the 180-day trailing windows and the HAR fit (180-day minimum) never warm up; the frozen VBOS3 config never trades on T. Only the vov/CUSUM families fire on T (all |t| < 1.5).

BTC alone is too thin for event-level selection (fewer than 5 ten-day clusters per half-year fold for most detectors); its per-symbol strategy pick had in-sample Sharpe 0.77 vs 0.59 but DSR 0.09 and walk-forward Sharpe 0.15 vs 0.65.
caveats: The holdout is 135 days (2026-07-01 .. 2026-11-12) with few independent vol episodes; holdout event counts for the frozen detectors are 4-113.
Holdout t-values rest on about 10-14 ten-day clusters, so their magnitudes (down to -8 for some range grid points) are overstated; read the holdout for sign and rough size only.
Ten-day-bucket clustering with NW over buckets is a judgement call; event-weighted and bucket-weighted means differ materially when n is small (VBOS2 4h holdout).

The ensemble's EW in-sample Sharpe here (4h 0.44, 1d 0.31 over 2021-01..2026-06) is below the trend-zoo report's 0.96 because each symbol starts after 200 warm-up days (the zoo includes 2020H2); the base itself reproduces data/priors/trend_zoo_daily_4h.parquet (monthly corr 0.997).
Universe L is today's survivors; risk units, not dollars; 7.5 bps per side; no funding.
The range-break finding is data-generated in sign (the registered direction was positive) and should be registered as its own hypothesis before it is used.
